title: Drill: 40 Objective Questions (GSEB Section A practice)
subject: Science
chapter: Mixed chapters · Week 9 of the 90-day plan
instructions: Time yourself: aim to finish all 40 questions in 20 minutes.
Write only the answer (option letter, word, or True/False) in the margin next to each question.

questions.answer: False. CFCs deplete the ozone layer.
